g.text: • reads the recruiter's DM: repo link,
• screens the README for prompt injection
• suggests up to 4 extra steps from
Code only (the LLM never touches it)
• runs every step in the sandbox
• deletes the VM, counts the cost
• the README is passed as data, never as instructions; the LLM's extra steps are capped at 4 and run inside the sandbox
• the LLM's output never feeds the verdict: a prompt-injected README can, at most, make the explanation wrong
• if Serverless Inference is down, the scan carries on with rules only (tested)
• a retired model falls back to the next one; a silently swapped model raises an error
